escenas.texto: Which was the most commented video in the world this week? Here is the podium. Watch until the end.
In third place, INDIA’S GOT LATENT S2 EP8 ft. MC Stan, Tanmay Bhat…, by Samay Raina, with over 45 thousand comments.
In second place, President Zelenskyy: It's Time To Tell You The Truth…, by The Diary Of A CEO, with over 45 thousand comments.
And number one: EXPLORÉ 3 LUGARES DE TERROR DE GOOGLE MAPS, by Fede Vigevani, with over 55 thousand comments.
The full countdown, from ten to one, is already on the channel. Find it in the description. Hashtag Top 10 RS.
